headline: UK pentester claims Bitcoin bounty in PHP2Shell capture-the-flag challenge
summary: A "Steal My Bitcoin" challenge offering a bounty to anyone who could breach a deliberately vulnerable PHP website using the disclosed PHP2Shell flaws has been won: a UK pentester known as 'killa' claimed the $2,000 Bitcoin prize, beating the challenge in around three hours.

claims.statement: The "Steal My Bitcoin" challenge offered a bounty to breach a vulnerable PHP website using the PHP2Shell flaws.
